standard-dialogue.npc: Move along then. I have a lot of work to be doing.

after-the-final-dawn.npc: Good day to you, adventurer. Do you need something?

after-the-final-dawn.player: No. Just thought I'd come and see how things are going.

after-the-final-dawn.npc: Things are very well thank you. Prince Itzla has tasked me with keeping an eye on the remaining Emissaries.
Swift justice must be dealt if they try anything, but until then, the Prince would prefer we not stir the pot. They no longer pose a real threat now their leaders have gone.

after-the-final-dawn.player: Well, I'm glad to hear all is well. Until next time.

after-the-final-dawn.npc: Indeed. May the sun light your way, adventurer.
